Record Class ReportSummaryModels.OpenView

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.doctor.history.ReportSummaryModels.OpenView
Record Components:
schemaVersion - response schema
empty - whether no Allure HTML report exists yet
emptyMessage - empty-state text with generate_test_report CTA when empty
reportPath - absolute or workspace-relative HTML path when found
resultsPath - related allure-results path when known
opened - whether the host attempted to open the report in a browser
ctaTool - generate_test_report when empty, else blank
warnings - non-fatal notes
Enclosing class:
ReportSummaryModels
public static record ReportSummaryModels.OpenView(String schemaVersion, boolean empty, String emptyMessage, String reportPath, String resultsPath, boolean opened, String ctaTool, List<String> warnings) extends Record
Open-Allure result for MCP report_open / CLI shaft report open.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
